resources.string: Brings Glass TV Launcher back when the TV\'s built-in home screen opens. It only watches for the built-in launcher\'s window and does not read screen content or intercept buttons.

Lets you choose what the remote\'s app buttons, Recent Apps and Settings buttons do. Only those buttons are handled; other buttons pass through. It also keeps a small, blurred snapshot of the app in front for the app switcher\'s cards, stored only on this TV. Screen text is never read.
